# Analyze seasonality: when are yellowtail caught?
trips = tables['trips']
s2_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 2].copy()

# Calculate yt_per_angler for each trip
s2_trips['yt_per_angler'] = s2_trips['yt'] / s2_trips['anglers']

# Group by DOY to see when fish are caught
doy_summary = s2_trips.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'count', 'mean'],
    'yt_per_angler': 'mean'
}).round(3)
doy_summary.columns = ['total_yt', 'num_trips', 'avg_yt_per_trip', 'avg_yt_per_angler']
doy_summary = doy_summary.reset_index().sort_values('total_yt', ascending=False)

print("Top 15 DOYs by total yellowtail caught in Season 2:")
print(doy_summary.head(15))
print("\nBottom 10 (weak signals):")
print(doy_summary[doy_summary['total_yt'] > 0].tail(10))

print("\n\nLast 30 days of data (around DOY 152-182):")
recent = doy_summary[(doy_summary['fish_date_doy'] >= 152) & (doy_summary['fish_date_doy'] <= 182)]
print(recent.sort_values('fish_date_doy'))
